title: Taiga Acala (StableAsset pool 0, tDOT LSD) — pool bricked by Homa rate drop; $0 extractable
closed_reasons: StableAsset pool 0 gate: collect_yield() requires D(updated) >= total_supply; D(updated)=2,982,897,093,946,633 < supply=3,039,652,087,142,047 (deficit 5,675.4993195414 DOT-eq) because the Homa LDOT exchange rate fell 2.87% below the pool's stored rate
All five value-moving extrinsics (mint, swap, redeem_proportion, redeem_single, redeem_multi) call collect_yield first and revert with InvalidPoolValue; deterministic, caller/amount independent
No admin/withdraw/rescue extrinsic in the deployed pallet (nutsfinance-stable-asset@aa101e87); create_pool/modify_a/modify_fees/modify_recipients are root/council-only and move no assets
Sudo.Key is the pallet account modl aca/trsy (no private key) -> sudo unusable
No XCM/EVM path: the pallet account cannot sign; no precompile or pallet code can move its DOT/LDOT
Donations to un-brick are captured by the yield_recipient on the next interaction -> no attacker profit
No tDOT market exists (all Acala DEX pairs with StableAssetPoolToken(0) are Disabled); the only LDOT venue is a thin AUSD/LDOT pool (~19.5k LDOT)

poc.note: No Foundry project (Substrate chain). 5/5 = ci/run.sh verification checks: state+PoolInfo decode, gate math, archive timeline, full tDOT holder scan, valuation.
